newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Gammon wins Singapore contracts.
newsitem.headline: Gammon wins Singapore contracts.

text.p: Gammon Construction Ltd said in a statement on Thursday its Singapore subsidiary had won two major construction contracts in Singapore.

Gammon Pte Ltd would construct both the S$20.37 million Meralodge Condominium Housing Development and the S$26.19 million Schenker International Logistics Centre before the end of 1997, the company said.
The contract for the 13,044 square-metre 10-storey Meralodge Condominium block was awarded by Cycle and Carriage Properties (Hillview) Pte Ltd.
The statement did not say who awarded the other contract.
